title.narrative: Joining Forces for Africa (JOFA) - protecting children during the COVID-19 crisis and beyond

description.narrative: This action has been designed to respond rapidly to the global COVID-19 pandemic emergency. It seeks to address the most marginalised vulnerable population in the 5 target African countries: Ethiopia, Kenya, Mali, Senegal and Uganda. The action seeks to address the immediate protection needs of children and to assess the evolving needs of the target populations and ensure implementation approaches are modified for maximum impact.
